title: LLM论证行为基准测试：人格攻击防御研究
summary: 研究评估LLM在政治辩论中应对人格攻击（ad hominem）的能力，通过构建对话博弈框架并与美国总统辩论语料库对比，发现多数LLM僵化地优先使用逻辑防御，无法像人类一样运用ethos反击，作者认为安全微调限制了其策略空间。
summary_en: This study benchmarks LLMs' ability to use and defend against character attacks (ad hominem arguments) in political persuasive dialogues. By structuring human defensive strategies into a dialogue game and comparing LLM-generated dialogues against the ElecDeb60to16-fallacy corpus of U.S. presidential debates, results show most LLMs rigidly prioritize logical defences and fail to exploit ethotic counterattacks. The authors argue safety fine-tuning constrains LLMs' strategic action space, preventing naturalistic interaction in domains where character contestation is normative.
